dialog: Hey it's me Peter Griffin here to explain my Xbox exclusive game "Virtual Stuck Behind A Bus Simulator".
One day the McRib was back and I was coming home to pick up the family when suddenly...
There was this stupid school bus in front of me.
I tried getting around it by clicking and dragging on the steering wheel to turn but the bus would just move in front of me.
Actually, that reminds me I need to get my car checked out since it would randomly drift from one side to another so I had to steer to stay on the road.
It was painfully slow so I had to break using the R key on my keyboard.
I couldn't slow down too much or else the guy in the hummer behind me would hit me so I occasionally had to press the Spacebar to accelerate.
Anyway that's about the entire game just get as far as you want to I guess.
